latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Thesis Title Generator skill.

- Generates three academically appropriate bilingual (Chinese-English) thesis title pairs based on the user's thesis content or related inputs.
- Titles prioritized for accuracy, academic tone, discoverability, and fulfillment of the thesis’ scope.
- Outputs include a rationale for each title option, a recommended title, and notes on terminology or overclaiming.
- Clearly indicates when only provisional titles can be generated due to limited input.
- Strictly avoids fabricating or overstating research methods, results, or contributions.
- Ensures output quality and adherence to bilingual title equivalence and academic style guidelines.
